card.name: Qualifier after a drug name
card.fires_on: The first piece of a qualifier that follows a product or ingredient name, such as USP after a diluent, (Human) after albumin or immune globulin, or NF after a gas. It also fires partway through a few drug-related words such as intravenous or intranasal.
